lines.en: label yumidorm35:
I knock on Yumi’s door, fully expecting to be turned away again as we haven’t really had much contact with one another following my decision to mention her mother.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Yumi 的门，满心以为又会被赶走——自从我决定提起她母亲之后，我们基本就没再怎么来往过。

lines.en: : Thank fucking God!
lines.zh: : 谢天谢地！

lines.en: : Get in here!
lines.zh: : 快进来！

lines.en: Or...I guess I’m going to be hastily invited inside for some reason?
lines.zh: 或者……看来我这次会被急匆匆地请进去？

lines.en: This is new.
lines.zh: 这倒是头一回。

lines.en: : Did I knock on the wrong door? Ami, is that you?
lines.zh: : 我敲错门了？Ami，是你吗？

lines.en: : I’m not your fucking weirdo [niece]!
lines.zh: : 我才不是你那个变态[niece]！

lines.en: : I need your fucking help with something. I have no idea what I’m doing right now.
lines.zh: : 我有事要你帮忙。我现在完全不知道自己在干嘛。

lines.en: : Okay but, just to be sure, you’re not holding a gun or anything, right?
lines.zh: : 好，不过先确认一下，你手里没拿枪什么的吧？

lines.en: : This level of excitement only makes sense from you if you’re getting ready to assassinate me.
lines.zh: : 你会这么兴奋，除非是准备要暗杀我，否则说不通。

lines.en: : I don't have a fucking gun! I’m not that weirdo blonde chick either!
lines.zh: : 我没有枪！我也不是那个金发怪妞！

lines.en: : Are you coming in or do I have to go out there and {i}pull{/i} you in by your fucking collar?
lines.zh: : 你到底进不进来，还是要我出去揪着你的领子把你{i}拖{/i}进来？

lines.en: scene black
I do my best to stifle the erection forming as a result of Yumi’s sudden switch in personalities and open the door.
lines.zh: Yumi 突然变了个人似的，我拼命压住因此勃起的部位，推开了门。

lines.en: scene yumicomp1
Instead of being on her side of the room like she normally is, Yumi sits with her legs crossed underneath the table and nervously prods at some of the keys on Chika’s laptop.
lines.zh: Yumi 没有像往常那样待在房间自己那一侧，而是盘着腿坐在桌下，紧张地戳着 Chika 笔记本电脑上的几个键。

lines.en: : What the fuck are “sticky keys” and why does this thing keep asking me if I want to turn them on?
lines.zh: : 「粘滞键」到底是什么鬼东西，为什么这玩意儿一直问我要不要开启？

lines.en: : Why would I ever want my keys to be sticky? That sounds gross as fuck.
lines.zh: : 我干嘛要让我的键变得黏糊糊的？听起来恶心死了。

lines.en: : Just hit no and it should go away.
lines.zh: : 点「否」就好了，它就会消失。

lines.en: : Why are you on Chika’s computer?
lines.zh: : 你为什么用 Chika 的电脑？

lines.en: scene yumicomp2
: Stupid fucking mall apparently does this thing where you have to apply online to work there, so Chika’s letting me use her thing.
lines.zh: : 那个该死的商场好像规定要网上申请才能去上班，所以 Chika 把她的机子借我了。

lines.en: : But I fucking hate computers and I have no idea what I’m doing.
lines.zh: : 但我他妈讨厌电脑，而且完全不知道自己在干嘛。

lines.en: : So...I need your help.
lines.zh: : 所以……我需要你帮忙。

lines.en: : Does this mean you aren’t mad at me anymore?
lines.zh: : 这是不是意味着你不生我气了？

lines.en: : Yeah, sure. Whatever. Helping me with a computer is totally enough to make up for evoking the horrible memories of my absent, junkie mother.
lines.zh: : 是啊，当然。随你。帮我弄电脑就完全可以抵偿你勾起我那个缺席的瘾君子母亲的糟糕回忆了。

lines.en: scene yumicomp3
: NO! I DON’T WANT TO TURN FUCKING STICKY KEYS ON! STOP ASKING ME!
lines.zh: : 不！我不想开什么狗屁粘滞键！别再问了！

lines.en: : You’re keeping the buttons pressed down for too long. Just tap them and let them go.
lines.zh: : 你按住键的时间太长了。轻点一下就松开。

lines.en: scene yumicomp4
: You do it.
lines.zh: : 你来。

lines.en: : Do what?
lines.zh: : 做什么？

lines.en: : You type for me. This is stupid and is going to take me all fucking night at this rate.
lines.zh: : 你替我打字。这太蠢了，照这速度我要打到天亮。

lines.en: : Sorry, I don’t have Chika’s permission to use her laptop. This is all on you.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我可没得到 Chika 的允许用她的笔记本。这事儿全靠你自己。

lines.en: scene yumicomp5
: Oh come the fuck on. I really don’t think she’ll care if it’s you.
lines.zh: : 拜托，别这样。我真不觉得她会介意是你。

lines.en: : If anything, she’ll probably fucking come home and lick her stupid keyboard just knowing you touched it.
lines.zh: : 要真说起来，她一回家知道你碰过，八成会把她那破键盘舔一遍。

lines.en: : That’s totally not creepy at all.
lines.zh: : 这一点都不瘆人。

lines.en: : Course it’s fucking creepy. You’re both creepy. The fuck does she even see in you?
lines.zh: : 当然他妈瘆人。你们俩都瘆人。她到底看上你什么了？

lines.en: scene yumicomp6
: Oh! Maybe it’s because you can’t go off and hang out with her mom!
lines.zh: : 哦！也许是因为你不能跑去跟她妈约会！

lines.en: : I’m sure something like that makes a huge difference.
lines.zh: : 我敢说这种事肯定差别巨大。

lines.en: Well...she's definitely still mad.
lines.zh: 嗯……她肯定还在生气。

lines.en: : I don’t think it does. I’m friends with several of the girls’ moms.
lines.zh: : 我觉得没什么差别。我跟好几个女生的妈妈都是朋友。

lines.en: : Of fucking course you are. Real glad to be a part of the club.
lines.zh: : 你当然是啊。真高兴自己也是其中一员。

lines.en: : Now, are you going to help me or do I have to bash your fucking brains in with this computer?
lines.zh: : 那么，你到底帮不帮我，还是要我用这台电脑把你脑子砸出来？

lines.en: : Okay but, fair warning, I’m going to have to sit pretty close to you.
lines.zh: : 好，不过先说清楚，我得坐得离你挺近才行。

lines.en: scene yumicomp7
: Whatever. It’s not like your fucking tongue hasn’t been halfway down my esophagus by now.
lines.zh: : 随便。反正你的舌头都已经伸进我食道一半了。

lines.en: : There is no way my tongue is that long.
lines.zh: : 我舌头不可能有那么长。

lines.en: : It’s fine as long as you don’t try to touch me or some shit.
lines.zh: : 只要你不来碰我什么的就行。

lines.en: : But, now that I think about it, that’s probably too hard of a task for you.
lines.zh: : 不过现在想想，这对您来说大概太难了。

lines.en: : Maybe I should just fucking wait for Chika or something.
lines.zh: : 也许我还不如等 Chika 回来什么的。

lines.en: scene yumicomp8
I sigh to myself and take a seat next to Yumi, realizing that even if she {i}does{/i} freak out about our sudden increased proximity to one another, that we’ll be able to move past it.
lines.zh: 我暗自叹了口气，在 Yumi 身边坐下，心想就算她因为我们突然拉近的距离而{i}炸毛{/i}，我们也总能过去。

lines.en: That’s basically just how things work at this point.
lines.zh: 事到如今基本上就是这么个流程。

lines.en: She gets dismissive, I do something shitty, she gets mad, she needs help, I give help, she doesn’t want help anymore, rinse repeat.
lines.zh: 她摆脸色，我干点破事，她生气，她需要帮忙，我帮忙，她又不想帮了，循环往复。

lines.en: : Are you going to type or do I still have to do it?
lines.zh: : 你到底打不打，还是仍得我自己来？

lines.en: : You have to do it.
lines.zh: : 得你自己来。

lines.en: : People who are looking to hire someone your age are probably expecting someone with technical experience.
lines.zh: : 想雇你这个年纪的人，大概都希望对方有点技术经验。

lines.en: : Knowing how to use a computer is an incredibly valuable skill.
lines.zh: : 会用电脑是一项极有价值的技能。

lines.en: : Now, click on that bar at the top of the screen.
lines.zh: : 现在，点一下屏幕顶部那个条。

lines.en: scene yumicomp9
: This bar up here?
lines.zh: : 上面这个条？

lines.en: : Okay...now what?
lines.zh: : 好……然后呢？

lines.en: : Type in “Pornhub.com” and see what comes up.
lines.zh: : 输入「Pornhub.com」看看会跳出什么。

lines.en: : It’s a surprisingly useful resource for-
lines.zh: : 这是个意外好用的资源，用来——

: I’m not going to watch fucking porn with my teacher! Help me or get out!
lines.zh: : 我才不要和老师一起看黄片！帮我还是滚！

lines.en: : If you let me finish, you would have found out that Pornhub is a surprisingly welcoming community full of people who can give great advice and-
lines.zh: : 你要是让我说完，就会知道 Pornhub 是个意外友好的社区，里面的人能给出很棒的建议——

lines.en: : Fuck off! No!
lines.zh: : 滚蛋！不行！

lines.zh: : 你不是……在谷歌里打个「奶子」什么的就开干了吗？！

lines.zh: : 算了，别回答！我不想知道。

lines.zh: : 好吧。

lines.en: : Well, if you’re not going to listen to my first piece of advice, drag your cursor over that little box over there.
lines.zh: : 行吧，既然你听不进我第一条建议，就把光标拖到那边那个小框上。

: If this is another porn site, I swear to fucking God.

lines.zh: : 从那个列表里选你想申请的店。

lines.zh: : Chika 那家店怎么样？就列在那儿。

lines.zh: : 我不能跟 Chika 在同一家店上班。

lines.en: : Does she not want you there or something?
lines.zh: : 是她不希望你过去，还是怎么的？

lines.en: : I think {i}she’d{/i} be fine with it. But I’ve seen what they sell and shit and there’s no way I’d be able to...contribute or anything.
lines.zh: : 我觉得{i}她{/i}不会介意。但我看过她们卖的东西什么的，我根本不可能……有什么贡献之类的。

lines.en: : I’d be way out of place.
lines.zh: : 我会格格不入。

lines.en: : None of that shit would even look good on me anyway.
lines.zh: : 反正那些东西穿我身上也不会好看。

lines.en: : I don’t think that’s true.
lines.zh: : 我不这么觉得。

lines.en: : You definitely pull off your winter look really well and that’s not...low class or anything.
lines.zh: : 你那身冬装造型驾驭得确实很好，而且一点都不……廉价什么的。

lines.en: scene yumicomp12
: Are you trying to fucking hit on me right now?

lines.en: : Too bad.
lines.zh: : 可惜。

lines.en: scene yumicomp13
: Fuck you.
lines.zh: : 去你的。

lines.en: : So...what do I do now? Just choose a random place and apply there?
lines.zh: : 那么……现在我该干嘛？随便挑一家投了？

lines.en: : I mean, you’d be fine with most things at this point, right?
lines.zh: : 我是说，事到如今你干什么都行了吧？

lines.en: : Does it really matter which one you apply to?
lines.zh: : 投哪家真有那么重要吗？

lines.en: : I guess not when you put it that way.
lines.zh: : 你这么说我猜是不重要。

lines.en: : What about this one? T-Mobile?
lines.zh: : 那这家怎么样？T-Mobile？

lines.en: : Horrible letter. Pick something else.
lines.zh: : 这个字母太烂了。换一个。

lines.en: : Sprint?
lines.zh: : Sprint？

lines.en: : Why are you only naming cell phone stores?
lines.zh: : 你怎么净挑手机店？

lines.en: : I’ve like...been making Chika pay for my phone for a long time now and I feel really bad about it.
lines.zh: : 我……让 Chika 替我交了很久的电话费，心里挺过意不去的。

lines.en: : So if I could get like, a free phone plan or a discount or whatever it would probably make things easier on her.
lines.zh: : 所以如果我能弄到什么免费套餐或者折扣之类的，她应该能轻松些。

lines.en: : I hear those places work off commission too and I’ve got like...experience selling stuff and shit.
lines.zh: : 我听说那些地方还有提成，而且我……有卖东西的经验什么的。

lines.en: : I don’t really think it’s necessary to do something like that for Chika.
lines.zh: : 我真觉得你没必要为 Chika 做这种事。

lines.en: scene yumicomp14
: Hey, you might not realize this, but everyone else isn’t made of money, dick.
lines.zh: : 喂，你可能不知道，但不是人人都像你一样有钱，蠢货。

lines.en: : Chika works her ass off to pay for all three of our phones {i}and{/i} groceries. The fuck do you do?
lines.zh: : Chika 拼死拼活地干活，付我们三个人的电话费{i}和{/i}伙食费。你又干了什么？

lines.en: : The first half of what you just said.
lines.zh: : 你刚才说的前半句。

lines.en: : What? The hell does that even mean?
lines.zh: : 什么？这到底是什么意思？

lines.en: : I pay for all three of your phones.
lines.zh: : 你们三个人的电话费是我付的。

lines.en: scene yumicomp15
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.zh: : 是啊。所以去手机店打工帮不上你想要的那个忙。

lines.en: : But I guess it would save {i}me{/i} some money so...yeah, go ahead and click on the Sprint application.
lines.zh: : 不过我想那样能给{i}我{/i}省点钱，所以……行吧，点开 Sprint 的申请吧。

lines.en: : Wait wait wait wait wait...
lines.zh: : 等等等等等……

lines.zh: : 是吧？

lines.zh: : 你没让 Chika……用{i}做{/i}什么事来回报吧？

lines.en: : I blame Chinami. Saying no to a cute girl in a dog helmet is apparently not a thing I can do.
lines.zh: : 这得怪 Chinami。戴着狗头盔的可爱女孩提出要求，我显然是拒绝不了的。

lines.en: : Why include me, though? Why not just pay for those two?
lines.zh: : 可为什么把我也算进去？为什么不只替她们两个交？

lines.en: : Don’t ask questions that you’re going to yell at me for answering.
lines.zh: : 别问那种我回答了你会冲我吼的问题。

lines.en: : I won’t fucking yell at you this time. I just don’t get it.
lines.zh: : 这次我不会吼你。我就是不明白。

lines.en: : It’s because I care about you just as much as I care about them.
lines.zh: : 因为我和在乎她们一样在乎你。

lines.en: scene yumicomp16
: Oh bullshit! It’s gotta be something else!
lines.zh: : 放屁！肯定有别的原因！

lines.en: : You can like...probably spy on the pictures I take or something! Can’t you?
lines.zh: : 你大概可以……偷看我拍的照片什么的吧！是不是？

lines.en: {i}Can I?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我可以吗？{/i}

lines.zh: 这个我得查一下。

lines.en: : See? You’re yelling at me.
lines.zh: : 看吧？你在吼我了。

lines.en: : Because I asked you a serious question and you responded with an outright lie!
lines.zh: : 因为我问了个正经问题，你却用彻头彻尾的谎话回答我！

lines.zh: : 嗯哼。总之，点 Sprint。

: R-Right. Sure.

lines.en: Yumi’s hands begin to shake as she drags her finger across the trackpad and selects the phone store.
lines.zh: Yumi 用手指划过触控板、选中那家手机店时，手开始发抖。

lines.en: Or, I guess it’s possible that they’ve been shaking for some time now.
lines.zh: 或者，我想它们可能已经抖了一阵子了。

lines.en: I admittedly haven’t been watching.
lines.zh: 我承认我之前没在注意。

lines.en: Not because I don’t want to. I mean, she’s adorable in her pajamas.
lines.zh: 不是因为我不想看。我是说，她穿着睡衣的样子很可爱。

lines.en: But because the closer I am to her, the more on-guard she is.
lines.zh: 而是因为我离她越近，她就越戒备。

lines.en: And despite this room being her natural habitat, she’s still the prey right now.
lines.zh: 尽管这间屋子是她的地盘，眼下她仍是猎物。

lines.en: She understands that. And the moment she feels cornered, she’ll attack.
lines.zh: 她明白这一点。一旦觉得自己被逼到角落，她就会反咬。

lines.en: : Okay. Now what do I do?
lines.zh: : 好。接下来我干嘛？

lines.en: : Move to the next column and start typing in your info.
lines.zh: : 移到下一栏，开始填你的信息。

lines.en: : Okay...yeah.
: It will probably take me a little while, so...sorry if you get bored or whatever.
lines.zh: : 可能要花点时间，所以……你要是觉得无聊什么的，先说声抱歉。

lines.en: : That’s fine. I have all night.
lines.zh: : 没关系。我有一整晚。

lines.en: One by one, Yumi presses down on the keys with her index fingers.
lines.zh: Yumi 用食指一个一个地按下按键。

lines.en: She hasn’t memorized where all of the characters are yet, so she definitely takes some time to make sure she gets everything correct.
lines.zh: 她还没记住所有字符的位置，所以肯定要花点时间确认没打错。

lines.en: I’m a little surprised she’s managed to make it this far into life without ever really using a computer-
lines.zh: 我有点意外，她长这么大居然几乎没怎么用过电脑——

lines.en: But, then again, when you live your entire life just wandering around the streets, picking the locks on pachinko machines and...buying ice cream or something-
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，当你一辈子都在街上晃荡、撬弹珠机的锁、还有……买冰淇淋什么的——

lines.en: You miss out on certain things that other girls don’t have any issues with.
lines.zh: 你就会错过一些别的女孩根本不觉得是问题的事。

lines.zh: : 我又不是什么白痴！

lines.zh: : 好了。

lines.en: : Well...yeah. I’m not a fucking lesbian, dude.
lines.zh: : 呃……对啊。我又不是百合，老兄。

lines.en: : Wow. This is one of the greatest moments of my life.
lines.zh: : 哇。这是我人生中最棒的时刻之一。

lines.en: scene yumicomp19
: What did I do wrong this time?!
lines.zh: : 这次我又哪里弄错了？！

lines.en: : Yumi, it’s asking you what sex you {i}are{/i}. Not for your experience or who you'd prefer to fuck.
lines.zh: : Yumi，它是{i}在{/i}问你的性别。不是问你的经验，也不是问你更想上谁。

lines.en: : Are you really that bad at this or are you just trying to get me to fall in love with you?
lines.zh: : 你是真的这么差劲，还是想让我爱上你？

lines.en: scene yumicomp21
: I’m {i}that{/i} bad, okay?!
lines.zh: : 我就是{i}这么{/i}差劲，行了吧？！

lines.en: : Sorry for being such a fucking moron!
lines.zh: : 抱歉我是个蠢货！

lines.en: : Don’t worry. I’m sure I sucked the first time I used a computer as well.
lines.zh: : 别在意。我第一次用电脑的时候肯定也很烂。

lines.en: I obviously don’t think I was {i}this{/i} bad...but I can at least humor her for now.
lines.zh: 我当然不觉得自己有烂到{i}这个{/i}地步……不过眼下至少可以哄哄她。

lines.en: scene yumicomp22
: Ugh...whatever.
lines.zh: : 呃……随便吧。

lines.en: : Can you look away for this part too?
lines.zh: : 这部分你也能转过头去吗？

lines.en: : Your phone number?
lines.zh: : 你的电话号码？

lines.en: : Yeah. I don’t want you sending me fucking...gross pictures at ungodly hours of the day.
lines.zh: : 对。我可不想你在三更半夜给我发些恶心的照片。

lines.en: : Are...there hours that {i}are{/i} okay?
lines.zh: : 那……有哪个时段{i}是{/i}可以的吗？

lines.en: : Fuck no. Never send me anything ever.
lines.zh: : 他妈的没有。永远别给我发任何东西。

lines.en: : Are you going to look away...or?
lines.zh: : 你到底转不转头……还是？

lines.en: : Oh. No. I think I deserve to know your phone number on account of me paying for it and all that.
lines.zh: : 哦。不转。既然是我在付钱，我想我有资格知道你的号码。

lines.en: scene yumicomp23
: Uhh...isn’t that technically blackmail?
lines.zh: : 呃……这严格来说算不算勒索？

lines.en: : Blackmail? No. Manipulation? Probably.
lines.zh: : 勒索？不算。操纵？大概算。

lines.en: : I won’t send you any pictures. Don’t worry.
lines.zh: : 我不会给你发照片的。放心。

lines.en: : But if there’s an emergency with Chinami or something, I’d like to be able to let you know.
lines.zh: : 但如果 Chinami 有什么紧急情况，我希望能通知到你。

lines.en: : Dick move, using the Chinami card against me. That’s not fair.
lines.zh: : 拿 Chinami 来压我，这招真卑鄙。不公平。

lines.en: : Yeah, well, life isn’t fair sometimes. Get used to it.
lines.zh: : 是啊，人生有时候就是不公平。习惯就好。

lines.en: scene yumicomp24
: Fine...
lines.zh: : 行吧……

lines.en: : But only cause you pay and shit.
lines.zh: : 但只是因为你在付钱什么的。

lines.en: : I’m not answering if you just call me to “talk” or whatever.
lines.zh: : 你要是只是打电话来「聊天」什么的，我可不接。

lines.en: $ yuminumber = True
{i}Congratulations! You now have Yumi’s phone number!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}恭喜！你获得了 Yumi 的电话号码！{/i}

lines.en: Yumi finishes typing in her phone number and slowly begins to move through the rest of the application.
lines.zh: Yumi 填完电话号码，开始慢慢地往下填申请表剩下的部分。

lines.en: She does this for a few more stores with slightly lower standards like fast food places and pet shops before finally deciding to close the laptop and call it a night.
lines.zh: 她又照这样投了几家要求稍低的店，比如快餐店和宠物店，最后决定合上电脑，今天就到这儿。

lines.en: scene black
She gets a text message from Chika shortly after that saying that she’s on her way home and, just as I expected, I was subsequently kicked out of the room.
lines.zh: 没过多久她收到 Chika 的短信说自己在回家的路上，正如我所料，我随后就被赶出了房间。

lines.en: But at least today’s visit ended on a much more positive note than the one regarding her mother.
lines.zh: 但至少今天的拜访，比起上次提到她母亲那次，收尾要积极得多。

lines.en: Seeing new sides of Yumi is always interesting, especially when they result in the color of her cheeks flushing to the point where they match her pajamas.
lines.zh: 看到 Yumi 新的一面总是很有意思，尤其是当这一面让她脸红到和睡衣一个颜色的时候。

lines.en: I hope to one day see that same level of redness in significantly less wholesome context.
lines.zh: 希望有一天能在不那么正经的场合看到同样程度的红。

lines.en: $ yumi_love += 1
$ yumidorm35 = True
{i}Yumi’s affection has increased to [yumi_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Yumi 的好感度提升到了 [yumi_love]！{/i}
